name: chain
label: chain (ch)
meaning: Chain stitch. Foundation of crochet, used between stitches as spacers.

name: slip-stitch
label: slip stitch (sl st)
meaning: Slip stitch. Drawn as a filled dot.

name: sc-plus
label: single crochet — plus variant (sc)
meaning: Single crochet, plus-sign variant. Both '+' and '×' are commonly used for sc.

name: sc-cross
label: single crochet — cross variant (sc)
meaning: Single crochet, cross/X variant. Both '+' and '×' are commonly used for sc.

name: hdc
label: half double crochet (hdc)
meaning: Half double crochet. T-shape with no tick on stem.

name: dc
label: double crochet (dc)
meaning: Double crochet. T-shape with one tick on stem.

name: tr
label: treble crochet (tr)
meaning: Treble crochet. T-shape with two ticks on stem.

name: dtr
label: double treble crochet (dtr)
meaning: Double treble crochet. T-shape with three ticks on stem.

name: sc2tog
label: sc2tog
meaning: Single crochet 2 together. Two stems converging at base.

name: sc3tog
label: sc3tog
meaning: Single crochet 3 together. Three stems converging at base.

name: dc2tog
label: dc2tog
meaning: Double crochet 2 together. Two ticked stems converging at base.

name: dc3tog
label: dc3tog
meaning: Double crochet 3 together. Three ticked stems converging at base.

name: 3-dc-cluster
label: 3-dc cluster
meaning: 3-dc cluster. Three double crochets worked into the same stitch and joined at top, drawn as three ticked stems bundled in an almond outline.

name: 3-hdc-cluster
label: 3-hdc cluster / puff / bobble
meaning: 3-hdc cluster, also called puff stitch or bobble. Three hdc worked into the same stitch, drawn as three plain stems in an almond outline.

name: 5-dc-popcorn
label: 5-dc popcorn
meaning: 5-dc popcorn. Work 5 dc into the same stitch. Drop the loop from the hook and insert hook into the first dc of the group. Pull the dropped loop through the first dc to close, creating a 3d nubble. Shown as five ticked stems in an almond outline with a horizontal bar through the middle indicating the closure.

name: 5-dc-shell
label: 5-dc shell
meaning: 5-dc shell. Five dc worked into the same stitch and spread open, forming a fan. Stems splay outward from a single base point, each with its own tick and top crossbar.

name: ch-3-picot
label: ch-3 picot
meaning: Chain-3 picot. Three chain stitches joined back to the base, forming a small decorative loop.

name: fpdc
label: front post dc (FPdc)
meaning: Front post double crochet. Worked around the post of the stitch below from the front of the work. Drawn as a dc with a hook curving to the right at the base.

name: bpdc
label: back post dc (BPdc)
meaning: Back post double crochet. Worked around the post of the stitch below from the back of the work. Drawn as a dc with a hook curving to the left at the base.

name: worked-in-back-loop
label: worked in back loop only
meaning: Indicates the following stitch is worked into the back loop only. Symbol appears at base of stitch being worked. Drawn as an arc opening downward (∩).

name: worked-in-front-loop
label: worked in front loop only
meaning: Indicates the following stitch is worked into the front loop only. Symbol appears at base of stitch being worked. Drawn as an arc opening upward (∪).
